description: Behavior traces: input scripts run on a Radix page in Chromium (reference/pages/trace-<fixture>.html) and on the same fixture in Div (div-components-render trace). After the page is ready and after each step, both sides record every element with a data-slot (named slot#k in tree order), the listed attributes, the number of element children, and the focused element. reference_harness.py trace compares them.

traces.description: Tab into the list, arrows (wrapping, skipping the disabled trigger), Home, End, a cross-axis arrow, Tab to the panel and Shift+Tab back to the trigger

Shift+Tab out of the list, which is the first tabbable element: Radix makes the list untabbable while the browser moves focus back. Chromium then leaves the document (focus on body); Div wraps to the last tabbable element, the panel, by design (div-engine interaction.rs next_focus_target)
Click the second trigger, the disabled third (the click reaches the list), the first, then Tab into the panel
Vertical tabs: up and down move focus, left and right do nothing
Manual activation: arrows move focus only; Enter and Space select
